gen.title: Estimating doubling time with the Rule of 72

cards.stem: What does the Rule of 72 help you estimate about an investment?
options: estimate how your investment will grow over time
calculate the exact interest earned in one year
determine the price of a pizza slice
find the legal interpretation of the policy
cards.quote: The Rule of 72 is a great way to estimate how your investment will grow over time.

cards.stem: What do you divide the number 72 by to estimate doubling time?
options: your investment’s expected rate of return (interest rate)
your monthly pizza spending
the initial $100 deposit
the number of slices per year
cards.quote: Simply divide the number 72 by your investment’s expected rate of return (interest rate).

cards.stem: What does the Rule of 72 tell you when you know the interest rate?
options: how long it will take for your investment to double in value
how much pizza costs per day
how many students take the class
how to calculate exact legal policy
cards.quote: If you know the interest rate, the Rule of 72 can tell you approximately how long it will take for your investment to double in value.

cards.stem: About how often will an investment double if the expected rate of return is 9%?
options: about every 8 years
after five years
in 10 years
in 25 years
cards.quote: Assuming an expected rate of return of 9%, your investment will double in value about every 8 years (72 divided by 9 equals 8).
